top_signals.title: Himalayan Dam Burst Fears Send Rescuers Fleeing for Safety
top_signals.summary: Rescuers have been urged to rush to safety after fears that a large dam created by debris-choked rivers might have burst on the border between Nepal and China, complicating a days-long search for hundreds of people still missing after deadly floods.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Radiant World and Its Founder Sued in Singapore for $34 Million
top_signals.summary: Radiant World Corp. and its founder are being sued in Singapore’s High Court by a local trade-finance firm, adding to mounting legal pressure on the iron ore trader.
